caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a man shown in two views: one from the front and one from the back, both centered on a plain, light beige background. The figurine is dressed in a suit with a bowler hat and has both hands in its pockets. The colors on the figure are predominantly shades of brown, with areas of rust or wear visible on the surface, giving it a mottled appearance. There are remnants of lighter colors, possibly cream or white, on the jacket and pants, and some red coloring is visible on the tie and face. The face is detailed with black and red markings to denote features such as eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, and cheeks. In the rear view, a coin slot is visible on the upper back of the figurine, along with a screw just below the slot, suggesting that the object is a coin bank. The stance of the figurine is upright, with legs slightly apart and feet pointing outward. The background is bare, emphasizing the figure with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Politician Coin Bank
